resources.string: This is the first month. The freelancer has %1$d hours to accept it; nothing is paid before that. After that you confirm every month yourself.
Every month is a delivery of its own, within %1$d days.
Nothing renews by itself: %1$d days before a month ends you confirm the next one, and it is paid from your wallet then.
To end it, ask %1$d days or more before the month ends and it ends with that month; later, it ends with the next one.
The price stays as it is today for as long as you stay subscribed.
Confirm next month — by %1$s, or the subscription ends
The first month starts once the freelancer accepts it.
You are ending it — it ends on %1$s
The freelancer is ending it — it ends on %1$s
The next month was not confirmed
The next month starts now at the same terms, and its money is held from your wallet until you approve the delivery.
The money stays held in Dorr — the freelancer is paid only when you approve.
Ending takes notice: asked %1$d days or more before this month ends, it ends with this month; later, it ends with the next one (which you still confirm). You can take it back until then.
The freelancer is told when it ends
Services marked «Monthly» can be subscribed to — the work comes every month.
